Welcome to SJS Pet Care & Clinic — where every wag and purr matters! 

From health check-ups, dental care, surgeries, and grooming to toys, food, and accessories — we bring complete pet care under one roof.

Our mission is simple: to keep your furry family healthy, happy, and full of life.

On this channel, you’ll find:
Expert pet care & grooming tips
Vet-approved health awareness videos
Real stories from our clinic
Nutrition & seasonal care advice

Because at SJS, we don’t just treat pets — we care for them like family ❤️
